text:
Jordan (AE): Heads-up: Solstice Health wants a POC. Their legal/security checklist is strict: SAML SSO, SCIM (bulk + delta), granular RBAC tied to groups, domain claim verification, and full audit trail export. They also asked for three pricing scenarios: hosted baseline for dev, dedicated for production, and locked-down private install. Can Solutions + Security sketch a short POC scope and rough pricing for the execs?

Li (Solutions): I can run it. Proposed POC scope (recommended minimal): 1) SP-initiated SAML login test with role attribute mapping; 2) SCIM bulk import of 200 users + group sync delta; 3) RBAC check: map three groups to three roles and enforce resource-level access; 4) verify domain verification via TXT record and invite flows; 5) confirm audit event export (JSON) and retention behavior. Success = SSO + 200 users + role enforcement + exportable logs. Need from Solstice: IdP metadata, SCIM endpoint and test creds, DNS zone admin access (or TXT record proof), sample user CSV. Estimate 8 biz days for the test run if infra is available.

Jordan (AE): Their constraint: PHI-sensitive environment 79; they will not allow outbound SCIM traffic to public internet. They prefer either Private (air-gapped) or a VPC peered Dedicated. Also asked about key custody: customer-managed KMS.

Anika (Security): We can cover those. Private/on-prem supports customer KMS/HSM and no egress. VPC/Dedicated with private peering may satisfy their no-public-egress ask but needs network validation. Audit retention: default 90 days hosted; we can offer 1 year for enterprise customers via retention add-on. SAML: we support signed assertions, encrypted assertions if needed, and attribute mapping. For SCIM we require TLS1.2+; mutual TLS is available for Private. For the security questionnaire, please upload to secure intake (https://support.redwood.ai/upload) and assign to me. I'll return a redlined SRA within 48 hours of receipt.

Ravi (EngOps): Infra notes: We can spin a Dedicated trial with private peering in ~2 business days (network approvals permitting). Private on-prem deployment requires infra ticket + ops window  and typically takes 3-5 weeks for provisioning and validation. SCIM behavior: endpoints at /scim/v2/Users and /scim/v2/Groups; supports pagination and incremental sync with ?filter=lastModified gt "{ts}". For large imports use chunked requests of 200 users.

Li (Solutions): Sample SCIM payload for push-sync (send to their IdP team):

```
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "alice@example.org",
  "externalId": "emp-12345",
  "name": {
    "givenName": "Alice",
    "familyName": "Ng"
  },
  "emails": [{"value": "alice@example.org", "primary": true}],
  "groups": ["clinicians", "oncall"]
}
```

Li (Solutions): RBAC mapping: we recommend mapping SCIM group -> console role. For SAML we can map an attribute (eg: rolesClaim) to the same console role ids. Provide a short YAML example for their SAML team if needed.

Noah (Product): Product notes: we have three built-in role templates (owner, editor, viewer) and resource-scoped policies. Domain control: domain verification via TXT record and then ability to auto-approve invites from that domain. For export: audit events (auth, scim, admin-change) are available via console export and API; retention configurable contractually.

Jordan (AE): Pricing: Solstice asked for ballpark numbers to help budget. Breakdowns: hosted dev, dedicated 12mo commit (production), private install + integration (one-time).

Li (Solutions): Rough ranges (very approximate): Hosted dev: $0-$2k/mo (pay-as-you-go small usage); Dedicated (12mo commit): $30k-$80k/mo depending on throughput/SLA/support; Private on-prem: one-time implementation fee $120k-$400k (encompasses install, network validation, KMS/HSM integration) and then annual license $60k-$200k. Include a note: final pricing requires SalesOps + Procurement review.

Anika (Security): Addendum: SOC/HIPAA reports or an on-site audit will add to PS and legal time. If Solstice needs encryption key custody with FIPS HSM, that'll add to integration effort and cost. We'll flag any additional security controls in the questionnaire.

Ravi (EngOps): POC action items: - Solstice: provide IdP metadata, SCIM test creds, DNS zone owner contact or the TXT record value, sample user file. - Jordan: upload security questionnaire to support portal and assign to Anika. - Li: draft minimal config guide and a runbook for Wed trial. - Ravi: reserve Dedicated trial infra and check peering options. Timeline: prep 3 business days, run 3 business days.

Jordan (AE): I'll upload the questionnaire now and schedule the kick-off. Meeting set for Tue 09:00 PT (Solstice Sec + IT, Jordan, Li, Anika, Ravi). Noah 1 can you join to cover product-level domain/RBAC details?

Noah (Product): Yep I'll be there. Li 1 ping me if you want to rehearse mappings.

Li (Solutions): I'll send the minimal config guide and SCIM/SAML quickstart to Solstice today. I'll also prepare a short PoC checklist they can sign off. :white_check_mark:

Jordan (AE): Great team 1 thanks. I'll post the questionnaire link in the thread after upload.

Anika (Security): Once I have the questionnaire I'll start a risk review and post any blockers. If anything looks high risk we escalate to compliance and legal.

Ravi (EngOps): I'll start infra provisioning after Jordan confirms network contacts.

Jordan (AE): Thanks everyone.
